title: Build a vector
description:
Write `std::vector<int> countdown(int from)` that returns the numbers from `from` down to 1. `countdown(4)` gives `{ 4, 3, 2, 1 }`. For `from` below 1 it returns an empty vector.

Start with an empty vector and `push_back` one number at a time.
hints: Make `std::vector<int> result{};`, then count down with `for (int i{ from }; i >= 1; --i)` and `result.push_back(i);` each time. Return `result` at the end.
